description: Get the daily price history of one marine fuel at one port: one row per assessment date with price, currency, unit and collection time, plus high/low over the rows returned. Use when the user asks how bunker prices at a port moved over days or months. Needs the port's UN/LOCODE (resolve names with opa_get_marine_ports) and a fuel type: VLSFO, MGO_05S (MGO), HFO_380 (IFO380) or HFO_180. Requires a paid subscription or an active trial; other accounts get HTTP 403. The API rate-limits history more tightly than latest prices and caps the rows per request, so a long window can come back shorter than asked; the answer says when it does. Requires an eligible account entitlement. Use opa_get_plans for current access and pricing; the API response is authoritative.

fuel_type.description: Fuel series: VLSFO, MGO_05S (MGO), HFO_380 (IFO380) or HFO_180

name: opa_get_marine_fuel_history
title: Get Marine Fuel Price History
